analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses concern the same function, the same focused DLL decomposition, and the same two helper declarations; keeping them together lets one worker establish the helper family once and prove the witnesses in manual order.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: One group is permitted because 3 <= max_witnesses_per_group 12. The witnesses are deliberately kept together because they are the split and two rejoin/value cases of one recursive xizi_dllseg focus transformation and share the same helper family.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed focus-split and focus-close helpers in the group-local case_lib. For every generated theorem select the left disjunct. Use focus-split for entail_wit_1. For return_wit_1, show the suffix is nil because its start equals its stop, simplify the value definition, then focus-close. For return_wit_2, apply xizi_dllseg_unfold under node_next <> head to obtain nodes_after = node_next :: rest, simplify the value definition, then focus-close. Unfold xizi_dll_links only where the generated points-to syntax must be matched.
